en: Fixed `claude -p` and the Agent SDK running Bash unsandboxed when `--settings` or SDK settings that turn the sandbox on fail validation; Claude Code now stops at start-up and names the invalid setting
zh: 修复了当 `--settings` 或 SDK 设置中用于开启沙箱的配置未通过校验时，`claude -p` 和 Agent SDK 会在未启用沙箱的情况下运行 Bash 的问题；Claude Code 现在会在启动时停止并指出无效的设置项
